text:
Tariq: FYI - customer LumenAI reporting multiple card declines and ACH setup failing (timeout). Seeing processor decline_code: 61 and gateway message 'card_not_supported'.
Mina: Which invoice / charges?
Tariq: INV-10432, charges ch_04PQRS... x2. Cards last4 3782, 6010. ACH verify timed out twice.
Raj: 61 usually insufficient funds, but processor note 'card_not_supported' suggests BIN rules. Can we stop retries?
Kasia: Finance ok to pause autopay and offer wire or virtual card. We'll waive one late fee if paid within 72h. Need remittance when wire sent.
Mina: Pausing retries and setting account flag autopay_suspended. Deployed change.
PaymentsBot: autopay_suspended set for customer lumenai - retries cancelled.
Tariq: Customer requests fastest option; asks about virtual card. Kasia, do we accept virtual card settlements?
Kasia: Yes. For virtual card, require payment confirmation and last 4 digits + auth trace. We'll mark invoice settled-virtual once funds confirmed.
Mina: Creating Zendesk ticket Z#11888 and sending both wire + virtual card instructions.
ZendeskBot: Ticket Z#11888 created for LumenAI - payment failures.
Raj: Quick diagnostic: tokenization logs show merchant_type=software_services but gateway mapping sent MCC=5732 (electronics) — likely mismatch triggered bin filter. I'll open gateway case GATE-3338.
Tariq: Good catch. Also adding a temporary route to processor p-beta for 10% of this merchant's attempts to see if acceptance rate improves.
PaymentsBot: Routing change: p-beta rollout 10% for lumenai - initial results: 1 success, 1 fail.
Mina: Sent instructions to customer. Wire template (internal): Bank: Chase; Account: Redwood Inference, Inc.; Acct#: 222333444; ABA: 021000021; SWIFT: CHASUS33; Ref: LumenAI-INV-10432
Kasia: Finance ops will watch. Please attach remittance and bank trace to Z#11888.
Raj: Gateway case opened (GATE-3338) asking for BIN rejection details and recommended MCC mapping.
Tariq: Also adding a short-term rule in payments-gating to stop retries on 'card_not_supported' for 7 days for this merchant. Mina deployed it.
Mina: Rule deployed. Logs/command I used: `curl -s "https://payments.redwood/internal/merchant_flags?merchant=lumenai" | jq .`
Kasia: Noted waiver and ops checklist. We'll reconcile when funds arrive.
Tariq: Closing loop - Mina to update Zendesk with options, Raj to post gateway response, Kasia to confirm settlement on remittance, and I'll add BIN/MCC tests to the harness.
Mina: Done - ticket updated and customer replied they will try virtual card first.
PaymentsBot: Monitor set: escalate if >3 failed attempts in 12h for lumenai.
Kasia: Thanks team :thumbsup:
